reference: same requests on stock MTP, client concurrency one, per-request TTFT
decode_metric: maximum rolling ten-token TPOT from cumulative token arrival events
short_response_rule: use all available post-first-token intervals; one-token responses have no decode constraint

tracelab.mapping: tool-loop class adaptation; no per-turn semantic stage labels

gsm8k.mapping: Reasoning-class adaptation; generation scored as thinking, no separate answer-stage annotation

math500.mapping: Reasoning-class adaptation; generation scored as thinking, no separate answer-stage annotation

mooncake_toolagent.mapping: Tool-loop-class adaptation; no per-turn semantic stage labels; trace-derived hashed-prefix prompts

longbench_v2.mapping: Long-document/short-answer analogue of Summarizer; window exclusions must be reported

mixed_rate_rule: For request-rate datasets, agent session rate = groups * other request rate / other request count; both arrival spans scale together. For Mooncake, agent rate = 0.1 * trace-speed multiplier.
coverage: Each other dataset standalone and alongside real TraceLab in each of three context bands, over all listed rates and all three methods. Full unfiltered TraceLab tails remain a separate pending requirement.
adaptations: The model/hardware differ from the source paper; numeric SLO classes are transferred and zero-load TTFT is measured here.
Rolling ten-token windows are an explicit conservative operationalization of the paper's every-ten-token measurement.
Fixed finite request sets permit exact isolated/loaded matching; results are finite-replay measurements, not automatically steady-state capacity.
Application mappings outside ShareGPT and HumanEval are stated adaptations, not dataset-specific constants quoted by the paper.

secondary_reference.reported_method: P99 TTFT/TBT; 50 ms TBT for Llama3-8B and 100 ms for Llama3-70B; own-request TTFT budget 1 second per 1K newly processed tokens
secondary_reference.status: Separate sensitivity/reporting protocol; not interchangeable with ten-token speculative TPOT or silently used as the primary SLO.
